decisions.name: go-api-contracts
decisions.reason: The supported exported library API and wire contract change. Retain function types, Key representation and ErrInvalidKey while extending field values and documenting changed wire bytes.

decisions.name: go-behavior-tests
decisions.reason: Escaping changes meaningful encoding and decoding behavior, and the request asks for contract tests. Fixed external-package oracles test each direction independently; error and zero-result assertions protect rejection behavior; examples and bounded fuzzing supplement those tests.

decisions.name: go-core-style
decisions.reason: Writing Go production and test code warrants standard-library use, guard clauses, explicit error handling, gofmt and available verification tools.

decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
decisions.reason: No interface, constructor, dependency injection, options API or resource lifecycle changes. This is a pure codec using the standard library.

decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
decisions.reason: The existing package keeps its codec responsibility and import direction; no package is created, split, merged or moved.
